title: Upgrade Your Thermostat Before Winter for Only $120
gist: A Wired deal post recommends a refurbished Ecobee3 Lite thermostat at $120 during Ecobee's fall sale (ends October 21), arguing basic smart thermostats beat feature-heavy models.

insights.claim: Ecobee's fall sale (through October 21) sells the refurbished Ecobee3 Lite, rebranded Essential at $140 new, for $120 with free shipping and a three-year warranty, with refurbished Enhanced at $170 and Premium at $220.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Seasonal discounting pattern ahead of Black Friday for smart-home hardware.

insights.claim: The editor argues that most buyers need only app control and scheduling, not add-ons like occupancy detection or a built-in speaker, and finds Ecobee's wider security ecosystem a bit buggy while recommending the thermostat alone.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Suggests the value in smart thermostats is the core function, not ecosystem extras.
insights.locator: Psst—I’m going to let you in on a little secret
